"'''It'''" was an [[IT-3 Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] led a group of [[underdweller]]s on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an attempt to steal a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] from [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. While she was still in power on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] sent a [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]] to update the [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] of "It"&mdash;who was lurking in an old [[secret Imperial detention center]]&mdash;and program it to destroy the government of the New Republic. "It" was ultimately [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|destroyed]] itself by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], and [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]].
